# Creating an Array

#### Course: Learn Java Basics

## Creating an Array

An array is created by placing elements inside curly braces {}, separated by commas. For example,

```java
int[] age = {24, 23, 18, 19, 20};
```

Here,

- int - represents that the array can only include integer elements.
- [] - represents it is an array
- age - name of the array
- {24, 23, 18, 19, 20} - elements of the array

![An array that stores ages](data:image/png;base64,)

Since all elements in an array are stored in the same variable, you can access a specific element using its index. Let's see how this works.
